purpose: Keep vertical-specific Search and agent recommendations out of the universal baseline. A site activates one primary class and may opt into additional modules when they truthfully apply.

recommendedStructuredData: SoftwareApplication or TechArticle where genuinely applicable

checks.title: Make version and freshness context explicit
checks.evidence: Visible version/current-support context plus stable version or release-history URLs where the product is versioned.

checks.title: Keep important tasks addressable with stable crawlable deep links
checks.evidence: Representative task/API/example pages are reachable through ordinary href links and canonical URLs.

checks.title: Pair reference material with runnable or concrete examples
checks.evidence: Examples accurately match the documented version and do not depend on hidden UI state for basic retrieval.

documentation.notes: Do not invent Product/Article markup solely for Search appearance.

checks.title: Resolve article authors to stable author/profile identities
checks.evidence: Visible byline and matching Article author URL/ProfilePage or other truthful identity reference.

checks.title: Keep publication and significant-update dates visible and consistent
checks.evidence: Visible dates agree with datePublished/dateModified and are changed only for meaningful editorial updates.

checks.title: Expose first-hand evidence and original media where it materially supports the article
checks.evidence: Primary documents, observations, images, data or methodology are linked or explained on the canonical page.

editorial.notes: FAQ rich results were deprecated by Google in 2026; FAQ markup is not a current Google growth shortcut.

checks.title: Keep product identity and software metadata canonical
checks.evidence: Canonical product page names the product consistently and uses SoftwareApplication/WebApplication only when visible facts support it.

checks.title: Publish stable release or change history
checks.evidence: Current version/status can be traced to a changelog, release page or other stable dated history without fabricating release markup.

checks.title: Expose documentation, examples and support/trust as crawlable product-adjacent surfaces
checks.evidence: Product page and navigation provide ordinary links to real docs/examples/support/trust surfaces that exist.

checks.title: Advertise agent/API interfaces only when implemented
checks.evidence: Any API, MCP, A2A, WebMCP, Agent Skill or project-specific declaration maps to an implemented and appropriately scoped capability.

software-product.notes: Agent interfaces and llms.txt are interoperability features, not Google ranking factors.

focus: commerce agent protocols where actually supported

checks.title: Keep visible Product/Offer facts consistent with structured data
checks.evidence: Price, currency, availability, identifiers and offer facts agree between the page and structured data.

checks.title: Reconcile page, feed and owner-platform inventory/price state
checks.evidence: Merchant/feed freshness and owner-platform state are verified separately from public crawl observations.

checks.title: Make shipping, returns and seller identity easy to verify
checks.evidence: Stable public policy pages and seller identity are linked from relevant product/checkout surfaces.

commerce.notes: Commerce/UCP support should be a separate adapter/module, not a universal ARWP requirement.

checks.title: Keep name, address, contact and hours consistent on owned surfaces
checks.evidence: Canonical location/contact facts are visible and agree with LocalBusiness/Organization structured data where used.

checks.title: Verify external business-profile state as owner data
checks.evidence: Authenticated business-profile category, address, hours and status are reviewed without inferring them from the public website alone.

checks.title: Use real location/service evidence rather than generic local landing pages
checks.evidence: Location pages contain truthful local details, services, media or other first-party evidence and are not doorway variants.

local-business.notes: Local recommendations require geographic/business context and should not be generalized to non-local sites.

checks.title: Give each dataset/research release a stable canonical identity
checks.evidence: Canonical landing page and Dataset metadata identify the same release, creator/publisher and scope.

checks.title: Publish methodology, provenance and limitations beside the data
checks.evidence: Sampling/collection method, source provenance, caveats and negative results are available from stable URLs.

checks.title: Make citation, license and version history explicit
checks.evidence: License, preferred citation, release/version identifier and prior-version history are directly retrievable.

checks.title: Provide stable download or API access when the dataset is actually distributable
checks.evidence: Documented download/API URLs resolve to the declared version and format; restricted data is not falsely advertised as public.

research-dataset.notes: Negative results, sampling limitations and version history are evidence features, not defects to hide.

checks.title: Keep one canonical site/entity identity
checks.evidence: Canonical URL, visible site name and Organization/Person identity are coherent where applicable.

checks.title: Expose important information through crawlable stable links
checks.evidence: Important destinations are reachable through ordinary links and do not depend on site search or client-only interaction.

checks.title: Separate real freshness from visibility measurement
checks.evidence: Material updates carry truthful dates while Search/AI outcomes are measured independently rather than inferred from markup.

general.notes: Use a more specific vertical when the site has a clear primary purpose.
